column1: # Exact pinned client-go test evidence for Campaign 15 RegionCache batch, bucket, and TTL core.

column8: note

The parent suite is conservatively partial: Campaign 15 translates the selected TTL, bucket, overlap, and batch-location children below; background concurrency, TiFlash, and the unselected suite remainder remain external.
Canonical half-open load, insert, and lookup behavior is translated; background concurrency remains external.
Leaderless metadata remains representable; leader-required batch loading retries an all-leaderless reply, filters a mixed reply, and reloads the filtered suffix through caller backoff.
Split replacement invalidates the observed topology and installs ordered child boundaries without overlap; split RPC orchestration remains external.
Intersecting merge replacement removes covered cached children; merge RPC orchestration and the exact empty-end case remain external.
The exact finite [a,z], [m,z], and boundary-ending [a,m] ID lists are translated; cold production end-key lookup and concurrent snapshots remain external.
The cache advances through multiple rounds after the 128-region limit; BatchLoadRegionsFromKey continuation-key parity and live concurrent loads remain external.
Representative live lookups preserve inclusive start, exclusive end, and positive-infinity boundaries; the exact standalone table remains external.
The exact finite and positive-infinity ContainsByEnd table is translated; cold live-PD previous-region lookup remains external.
Insert and reload preserve missing, stale, and newer bucket-version rules; epoch-not-match and coalesced background refresh remain separately tracked.
The public path preserves half-open bucket boundaries and clamps stale bounds to the current finite or positive-infinity region; the original private raw-hole nil behavior remains external.
All finite and positive-infinity boundary shapes clamp returned bucket values to the current region; Go pointer-identity assertions remain external to Rust value semantics.
Atomic insertion removes exactly intersecting stale regions and preserves disjoint entries.
Flashback remains terminal while BucketVersionNotMatch publishes only newer metadata to the exact cached region; full flashback execution remains external.
Invalidation removes the observed snapshot and foreground lookup refills it; split-specific TryLocate and cache-scan assertions remain external.
ReloadOnAccess remains distinct and makes entry reuse fail; split-specific TryLocate and cache-scan assertions remain external.
Loaded and cached regions merge in source order while covered entries are removed and partial overlaps stay visible.
Range splitting preserves ordered half-open suffixes and positive-infinity progression; downstream request construction remains external.
Exact batch-scan requests, multi-round progression, and cache publication are translated; live PD scheduling remains external.
Fallback occurs only for exact Unimplemented and returns bounded ordered scan metadata without synthetic buckets through the same cache validation path.
Representative finite, infinite, hole, and reached-limit cases preserve the source coverage rules; the full source table remains external.
A gapped reply backs off before publication, cached overlap cannot mask the gap, and only a contiguous suffix at the exact response limit is inconclusive; live stale-PD convergence remains external.
The exact 128-region and 2048-input-range limits advance through bounded rounds without dropping suffixes.
